g.text: Elmo Is Going as Meryl Streep’s Evil Fashion Editor Miranda Priestly for Halloween This Year ◆ Kevin Bleyer, Emmy-winning ‘Daily Show’ Writer, Dies at 54 in Car Accident ◆ ‘Crystal Lake’ Hits 1.3 Billion Minutes Watched in 11 Days, Becoming Peacock’s No. 4 Scripted Debut Ever ◆ Television Academy Foundation Pacts With Best Buy to Launch Production Assistant Training Program for Los Angeles Area High School Students ◆ Danny Masterson Loses Appeal of Rape Conviction ◆ ‘Nobody Wants This’ Season 3 Opens With 6.2 Million Views in Four Days ◆
